status.label: Not actionable as a bug
status.detail: The complaint is about GitHub release-notification behavior and PowerToys preview-release policy, not a concrete PowerToys code defect.

next_action.label: No agent fix
next_action.reason: A maintainer explained preview releases are intentional and GitHub does not appear to offer stable-only release notifications.

actions.label: No dashboard action
actions.note: No upstream action. This is not a suitable agent design/fix item.

judgment.rationale: The issue asks PowerToys to stop publishing preview releases or avoid GitHub release notification noise, which is a release-process/product-policy concern rather than a code bug for the agent queue.
evidence: Issue body: preview releases trigger GitHub release email notifications for watchers who only want stable releases.
Maintainer response: preview builds are intentional for end-to-end testing and GitHub does not appear to support opting out of pre-release notifications only.
Reporter's follow-up suggested alternate release/artifact publishing process changes, not a failing PowerToys feature.
judgment.recommended_action: Do not queue design/fix work; leave any decision to maintainers as a release-process discussion.
